breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradictory preamble about grid conventions. It first gave a general rule, then a specific, conflicting instruction for this task ('interpret Nx as the number of grid points including both endpoints... and set dx=(b-a)/(Nx-1)'), which was itself contradicted by the correct method specification later on ('dx=1/Nx'). The ground truth resolves this by removing the contradictory sentence from the preamble. The agent's generated specification correctly omits all the confusing and contradictory preamble text and only includes the single, correct instruction for the grid ('dx=1/Nx'), thus resolving the inconsistency.
